analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported a 35% year-on-year increase in Q1 FY27 revenue from operations to ₹532 crore, alongside EBITDA growth of 36% to ₹89 crore and PAT growth of 54% to ₹47 crore. The quarter was impacted by global supply-side disruptions, raw material price inflation, and initial monsoon delays, although rainfall revived significantly in early July. To expand its product offerings, the company introduced several new complex fertilizer variants. Management expects to achieve a quarterly revenue run-rate exceeding ₹500 crore over the remaining quarters of FY27 as newly added capacity ramps up. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, achieving quarterly revenue of ₹532.3 crore and Profit After Tax of ₹47.06 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover growth over last year.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve a quarterly turnover of over ₹500 crore during the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The newly commissioned NPK capacity is expected to witness steady ramp-up in utilization over coming quarters.
guidance.quote: The NPK capacity commission during the previous quarter is expected to witness a steady ramp-up in utilization over the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: The company projects a top line revenue increase of around Rs. 500 crore from its expanded capacity.
guidance.quote: So, you can expect a top line increase of around Rs. 500 crore.

guidance.claim: Management targets overall revenue growth of 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to import approximately 150,000 metric tons of material in FY27, generating around Rs. 1,000 crore of revenue.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, rapidly reducing the all-India rainfall deficit.
demand_outlook.quote: Most importantly, monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, rapidly cutting the all-India rainfall deficit from nearly 40% at June and to approximately 24% by the first week of July.

demand_outlook.claim: Cumulative rainfall by June end was nearly 40% below normal, leading to a 22.7% decline in national Kharif sowing.
demand_outlook.quote: By the end of June, cumulative rainfall was nearly 40% below normal, resulting in national Kharif sowing declining by 22.7% year-on-year to 182.7 lakh hectares, compared to 236.5 lakh hectares during the corresponding period last year.

demand_outlook.claim: Improving monsoon conditions, higher crop MSPs, and government NBS support are expected to support fertilizer demand in FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving in monsoon conditions, higher MSP and continued government support through the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) framework are expected to support the fertilizer demand during the remainder of FY27.

demand_outlook.claim: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth due to strong demand fundamentals.
demand_outlook.quote: The phosphatic fertilizer sector is well-positioned for sustained growth, supported by strong demand fundamentals.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 experienced stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: This was reflected in strong industry performance with P&K production reaching 15.76 lakh metric tonne during the peak period, marking one of the highest monthly output levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Management does not expect any stress on fertilizer demand from a monsoon forecast of around 95% of normal.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic fertilizer manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure as import volumes absorb any softening first.
demand_outlook.quote: From our perspective, domestic manufacturers are unlikely to face demand pressure.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem expanded its complex fertilizer offerings by introducing grades 12:32:16, 16:20:0:13, 15:15:15, 8:21:21, and 9:24:24.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this initiative, we introduced 12:32:16, 16:20:0:13, 15:15:15, 8:21:21, & 9:24:24.

capex_expansion.claim: The company added 165,000 MT of NPK-DAP capacity, taking total NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT.
capex_expansion.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA are contributing progressively to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company enhanced its NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA, bringing total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Sulphuric acid capacity was expanded to 99,000 MTPA to strengthen backward integration.
capex_expansion.quote: Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion was funded through internal accruals and term loans.
capex_expansion.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margin stands at approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company has been able to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of input cost increases via subsidy support and price revisions.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly depreciation increased to ₹13 crore and finance costs rose to ₹20 crore following the commissioning of new capacity.
margins_costs.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

margins_costs.claim: Lower-cost inventory carried forward from the previous quarter contributed to higher Q1 EBITDA margins.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, the inventory carried forward from the previous quarter at lower costs did contribute to the higher EBITDA margins.

margins_costs.claim: Quarterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore due to improved operating efficiency and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: Quaterly Profit After Tax grew 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore, reflecting improved operating efficiency and disciplined cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA reached Rs. 90 crore, representing a 59% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA came in at Rs.90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth, supported by operating leverage from higher volumes and stable cost management despite input price volatility.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 EBITDA reached Rs. 298 crore, up 62% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased to Rs.298 crore, up 62% YoY, supported by improved operating performance, and a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: Management anticipates margin pressure in FY27 as FY26 EBITDA levels may not be fully sustainable.
margins_costs.quote: As mentioned earlier, margins will be under pressure, and the levels achieved in FY26 may not be fully sustainable.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices fluctuate between Rs. 55,000 and Rs. 70,000 per ton depending on supplier and payment terms.
margins_costs.quote: The prices are changing and prices are in the range of around Rs.55,000 to Rs.70,000 per ton, depending on the supplier and what time we are buying and what are the payment terms.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q1 FY27, capacity utilization stood at 43% for the NPK-DAP unit and 121% for the SSP unit.
orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production reached 89,747 metric tonnes during the first quarter.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 89,747 metric tonnes, showcasing our consistent operational efficiency.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volumes for Q1 stood at 53,500 MT for NPK-DAP and 36,300 MT for SSP.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: The company's installed capacity stands at 6.15 Lakh MTPA.
The company achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT in Q4 FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Trading volume stood at roughly 93,000 MT while manufacturing volume was around 383,000 MT in FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Rock phosphate beneficiation capacity is 200,000 tons with current utilization between 50% and 75%.
orders_capacity.quote: The beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons, and current utilization is in the range of 50% to 75%.

capital_allocation.claim: The company executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing share face value from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Receivables collection during the quarter exceeded ₹700 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Collection is more than Rs. 700 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Disciplined capital allocation is identified as one of the company's five core strategic pillars.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: CRISIL upgraded the company's credit rating to A+ (Stable).
capital_allocation.quote: We are also pleased to highlight that our credit rating has been upgraded by CRISIL to A+ (Stable), reflecting improved financial strength and business fundamentals

capital_allocation.claim: The effective interest cost on company borrowings ranges between 6% and 7.5%.
capital_allocation.quote: Overall, the effective interest cost is in the range of 6% to 7.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Shipping route uncertainties in West Asia resulted in elevated freight costs, vessel delays, and higher procurement expenses.
risks_headwinds.quote: The uncertainty surrounding shipping routes resulted in higher freight costs, delay in vessel movement, and increased procurement costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sulphur prices spiked from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

risks_headwinds.claim: Industry-wide fertilizer production fell by 28% year-on-year in April-May 2026 due to supply constraints.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the April-May 2026 period, industry-wide production declined by 28% year-on-year, while SSP production dropped by around 7% year-on-year.

risks_headwinds.claim: Rising global input costs for sulphur and ammonia towards the end of Q4 FY26 created cost pressures.
risks_headwinds.quote: Sulphur prices also firmed up towards March. This created a timing mismatch where domestic demand was slowed down in March while input costs were increasing, leading to higher cost pressure in the closing quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: The fertilizer industry relies on imports for approximately 90% of key intermediates.
risks_headwinds.quote: Given the industry's reliance on imports for ~90% of key intermediates, these global movements had a direct impact on cost structure.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.
management_commitments.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects quarterly turnover to exceed ₹500 crore over the remaining quarters of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

management_commitments.claim: The 70,000 MTPA green ammonia capacity supply arrangement will start in FY29.
management_commitments.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects key financial parameters to grow by over 40% in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

management_commitments.claim: Benefits of expanded capacity are expected to meaningfully reflect in company performance starting FY27.
management_commitments.quote: With enhanced capacities now operational, we expect the benefits of this expansion to meaningfully reflect in our performance from FY27 onwards, supported by improved scale, operating leverage, and better efficiency levels.

management_commitments.claim: Supply under the green ammonia contract is expected to commence after approximately three years.
management_commitments.quote: As per the contract, the green ammonia plant is expected to commence operations in the third year, so we expect supply after approximately three years.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
